 Conservative podcaster Brett Cooper says she's 'not part of' MAGA 'anymore', citing Trump's handling of the Epstein files and the Iran war
 By Morning Honey Staff 
 November 18, 2026 
 Add Morning Honey on Google 
 Brett Cooper declared she no longer belonged to MAGA. By: @IMBRETTCOOPER / INSTAGRAM 
 Tap Here to Add Morning Honey As A Trusted Source 
 Article Overview 
 Conservative podcaster Brett Cooper has officially distanced herself from Donald Trump's MAGA movement. 
 She expressed her frustration with his administration's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files and its decision to wage war against Iran.
 Brett Cooper on why she's leaving MAGA
 Brett Cooper admitted she had moved on from MAGA. By: @IMBRETTCOOPER / INSTAGRAM 
 In an interview , Cooper made her position clear. "I'm not part of [MAGA] anymore," she said. "I think I've moved on."
 Her admission marks a dramatic departure: during the 2024 presidential election, Cooper openly championed Trump and shared photos of herself on horseback wearing a MAGA hat.
 Cooper identified Trump's response to the Epstein files controversy as her first major red flag and recalled how he suggested that anyone who continued to demand answers about the files no longer belonged to MAGA.
 Brett Cooper once proudly supported Donald Trump. By: @IMBRETTCOOPER / INSTAGRAM 
 "OK, well, I guess I'm not!" she recalled thinking. The controversy marked the beginning of her growing distance from the movement. 
 Trump's decision to wage war against Iran only added to her disappointment. It was even more triggering because he had campaigned on a promise to avoid new wars. 
 "There was a lot of gaslighting that took place," Cooper said. "It's just been so belittling." 
 Her frustration has also changed the way she approaches political content. She recently turned down a paid advertisement from a Republican Super PAC ahead of the midterm elections.
 Brett Cooper questioned Donald Trump's handling of Epstein files. By: @IMBRETTCOOPER / INSTAGRAM 
 The copy urged voters to oppose "woke" politics and socialism, but Cooper felt she could no longer back that message. 
 "The recommended drafted ad copy was like, 'stop the woke left and these socialists and all of these things, and the Republicans are going to save you'. And I just don't agree," she explained.
 Though Cooper is no longer MAGA, she remains a conservative who will support Republican candidates. 
 Why former MAGA supporters are leaving Trump
 According to reports , several others are leaving MAGA. Rich Logis , a former Trump campaign volunteer, went on to establish a nonprofit called Leaving MAGA after he left.
 His organization offers support groups and meetups for people who want to reconsider their political beliefs. Logis described his former attachment to the movement as an addiction to fear and rage. 
 Several people are leaving Donald Trump's MAGA movement. By: MEGA 
 Another former supporter, Steven Francisci, discussed how self-reflection helped him question beliefs he had carried since childhood. 
 People also faced emotional consequences after distancing themselves from MAGA, ranging from strained family relationships to questions about identity and belonging.
